relationship.future_provider_rule: A partner provider must be explicitly approved and separately enrolled by the customer forum.
relationship.content_connection_separation: An Operator Service entitlement never grants, replaces, reveals, or expands a Content Connection credential or scope.

issuer.trusted_key_source: Forum-local protected configuration installed through an explicit customer-approved enrollment; never fetched from an entitlement-controlled URL.
issuer.key_rotation_rule: A new trusted public key is enrolled by a separate customer-approved action before it signs active entitlements. Old public keys remain available to verify retained audit history and may not issue new entitlements after their configured retirement time.
issuer.key_revocation_rule: Revoking a trusted key immediately disables every active entitlement signed only by that key and records a forum-local audit event.

entitlement.timestamp_format: RFC 3339 UTC with Z suffix and optional fractional seconds

rules: Enrollment is explicit, customer-authorized, and default-off.
A newly activated entitlement replaces any prior active entitlement for the forum and records the replacement chain.
During grace_read_only, mutation scopes are disabled and only entitled observation remains available.
Expired, revoked, replaced, invalidly signed, not-yet-valid, wrong-forum, or unknown-key entitlements grant no mutation authority.
prepare scopes create a bounded customer-visible proposal and never apply it.
apply_customer_approved scopes require an exact unexpired customer approval bound to the proposal, provider, forum, scope, and operation hash.

No entitlement authorizes changing the central contract, widening connection scope without customer approval, exporting secrets, changing credentials invisibly, or adding installation-specific product behavior.
Provider removal leaves the forum and ordinary DiscussionBridge operation functional without the service.

audit.secret_rule: Audit records contain identifiers, hashes, and sanitized outcomes only; never Content Connection secrets, signing private keys, lease tokens, or exported credentials.
audit.retention_rule: Audit history survives entitlement replacement and provider removal under the forum's approved retention policy.
